status: Device-resident F32 addition implemented and qualified in the learned-router MoE component chain; production session executor remains pending; whole goal active

implementation.backend: CUDA, exposed with existing resident request support on SM80+
implementation.arithmetic: One __fadd_rn per element, preserving F32 rounding, signed zero and subnormals without casts or fusion.
implementation.validation: Exact F32 extents, matching request/backend ownership, live views, aligned storage, bounded nonzero count. Read-only inputs may overlap; output must be disjoint from both. Invalid plans queue no work and leave outputs/request usable.
implementation.resources: No operator workspace or reserve step; one request-stream kernel. No execution allocation, copy or host fence.

validation.edge_scope: Independent Torch CUDA outputs for 32 directed pairs and their same-input sums: signed zeros, subnormals, normal/subnormal transitions, halfway ties, exact cancellation, overflow and infinities. Two requests, guards, unchanged inputs, alias and foreign/invalid/overflow rejection. Separate two-stream warm probe uses distinct expected outputs.
validation.full_composition: Native learned router, assignment sort, actual selected offloaded expert triples, fused and heavy tiers, fixed-k gather, shared F16 FFN, and device F32 routed-plus-shared final. The former CPU final-add diagnostic is removed. All preserved intermediates/final outputs match the paired source byte for byte; routed/shared inputs also remain unchanged after addition.
validation.policies: Both adaptive FP16-partial settings, both prefill/decode placement policies, and fused windows one/five. Heavy group shape and full-tier fused group width remain source-equivalent.
validation.sanitizers: Host ASAN/UBSAN edge fixture and full ten-case prefill composition; CUDA memcheck/leak check for edge fixture and largest composed case under prefill/decode, zero errors/leaks.

profile.scope: Isolated warmed F32 addition; setup/verification excluded; distinct outputs on two independent requests. Not complete MoE or vLLM timing.

limits: The composed schedule is still an external integration harness. Production BnSession/backend request orchestration, bounded reusable workspace setup and failure/cancellation cleanup remain required.

Native Trellis models currently have no legacy BnConfig vocabulary/context projection; existing backend session creation/matching/reset still uses legacy extents. Session integration must derive immutable native extents rather than mutating the legacy config.
The source cases use deterministic activations through actual layer39 weights. V4.1 defaults to zero hash-routing layers. Routed <=8 BC decode is outside this qualification.
Warm profile isolates addition only. Composed offload scans have zero decode-cache hits, synchronous uploads and host metadata planning; no warm-cache/full-inference performance claim.
Full attention/Engram/forward/generation/CLI, matched resident vLLM parity and continuous/chunked serving remain open.
